# HEIC regression fixture

`example.heic` is the upstream libheif example, fetched from:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/2f642b11f9e2d5df189cdba86208bde4bbe08618/examples/example.heic

Used to exercise genuine HEVC/HEIF decoding through the browser worker. Upstream license: LGPL-3.0; see the accompanying upstream COPYING file. This is a test asset, not event content and never posted to the real attendee feed.
